answer: Reaching the thread of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a user experience perspective, adoption barriers register, it stays short. The design leans on game-theoretic equilibrium in agent coordination. Each submission hangs on the gale of a task receipt, and the yarrow is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
